analysis_question: Does presentation-robust computational distinguishability exhibit materially heterogeneous behavior across pre-specified mechanism-parameter strata in the frozen braking domain?
claim_scope: Complete finite-domain descriptive census for the declared braking grid, 18 presentations, four computational agents, and six agent pairs; not a human-effect, causal, or cross-domain analysis.

main_text_promotion.rule: Promote to the main text only if the primary robust-nonzero range reaches 0.10 and every primary cell contains at least 100 valid kernels. Secondary thresholds are descriptive support and cannot substitute for the primary threshold.

anti_data_mining_boundaries: The nine friction-by-speed cells and all marginal levels are fixed before computing their outputs.
No additional interaction, adaptive binning, best-cell search, per-cell minimum-cover search, p-value, or sampled confidence interval is permitted.
Positive or negative delay deltas describe only the six declared computational-agent pairs and carry no human-learning or diagnostic-effect interpretation.
A primary cell below 100 valid kernels is not merged or re-binned; it makes the analysis appendix-only.
